A gated community of villas and apartments planned around courtyards, play courts and open lawns, on the northern edge of Bangalore.

Eden Orchards sits on Survey Nos. 198/1, 199/1 & 200/4 in Byadrahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk — a stretch of North Bangalore developing around green space and civic infrastructure. The project is a joint development between Shiva Stuti Developers and Mr. K. S. Harish, designed by Dutta Kannan Architects, Indiranagar.

Inside the boundary wall: three villa typologies, a 54-unit apartment building named The Mango Tree Estate, and a dedicated clubhouse with a swimming pool, sport courts and landscaped lawns — all reached from a single 7M-wide internal drive.

The Grand Entrance

A gate that sets the tone for what's inside

Stone cladding, timber louvres and landscaped signage walls announce the community before you've reached the clubhouse.

The Mango Tree Estate

54 apartments in a single G+6 tower

Eight homes a floor, a rooftop swimming pool and deck, and a ground-floor work-from-home office for residents who need a break from the dining table.

North Elevation

The Mango Tree Estate

Brick, timber louvres, and a garden at every turn

A red-brick facade with deep timber-lined balconies on every floor, landscaped courtyards at ground level, and a lobby and reception sized for a community, not just a building.
